overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by not approving minutes of 2011–2015 meetings before the complaint, accepted its August 2015 cure and two-month pledge as appropriate remedial action, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to consistently create and approve minutes of its meetings held between August 2011 and July 2015.
allegations.key_passage: While the Committee appears to have created draft minutes for meetings held between August 2011 and July 2015, it had not approved those minutes as required by G.L. c. 30A, § 22(c) at the time the complaint was filed.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
